name: ContentPen
author: contentpen

sections.description:
ContentPen is an AI-powered content writing assistant designed to help businesses create, optimize, and publish SEO-friendly blog posts at scale. By combining deep research with your brand’s unique voice, ContentPen crafts high-impact articles that outperform your competition.

Features

  • Brand Knowledge: AI-powered analysis of your brand voice, unique selling points, target audience, and competitors.
  • Keyword and Title Selection: Automated title suggestions and search intent alignment for SEO success.
  • Deep Topic Research: In-depth SERP analysis and content gap identification.
  • Optimized Blog Outline: Research-backed article structure with a semantic SEO approach.
  • High-Quality First Draft: Collaborative AI agents generating comprehensive content.
  • Quality Review and Optimization: SEO optimization to enhance article performance.
  • Final Enhancements: Strategic linking and automated images for appealing blogs.
  • Effortless Publishing: Seamless integration with WordPress and other CMS platforms (coming soon).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/contentpen directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->ContentPen screen to configure the plugin
  4. Enter your API key from https://app.contentpen.ai to start using the plugin
sections.faq:
What is ContentPen?

ContentPen is an AI-powered content writing assistant that helps businesses create, optimize, and publish SEO-friendly blog posts at scale.

How does ContentPen work?

ContentPen combines deep research with your brand’s unique voice to craft high-impact, SEO-optimized articles. It utilizes multiple AI agents to handle tasks like brand analysis, keyword selection, topic research, content drafting, and optimization.

Do I need an API key?

Yes, you need an API key to use ContentPen. You can get one by signing up at https://app.contentpen.ai
